round: Shape of the account room card
question: Shape of the account room card?

options.label: Boxed
options.description: The three lines inside a rounded box, so they read as one thing to deal with. 5 lines with the border.

options.label: Ruled
options.description: A rule down the left edge groups the lines without closing them in. 3 lines.

options.label: Bare
options.description: No edge at all, so the amber lead alone says where the card starts. 3 lines.
